bio: I'm a software developer based in Guadalajara, Mexico, passionate about building clean, scalable, and delightful web applications. I believe in sharing knowledge freely, making things people actually use, and writing code that other developers, including my future self, won't hate you for six months later.
This blog is where I publish my deep dives, side projects, and ideas worth sharing — mostly for future me, and hopefully useful for others too.

I created this space to share what I learn while working with modern technologies as I grow into a more well-rounded full-stack developer. I'm not trying to be perfect — I'm trying to document the journey, stay curious, and maybe, just maybe, help a few devs along the way.
This blog is my digital lab — part archive, part playground. If it helps someone else solve a problem, build a better app, or even just feel less alone in the learning curve, that's a win.
When I'm not coding, I'm probably studying something new, reading a book, watching anime or playing some video game.
